basic_info.description:
Nestled in the highly sought after Bernal Heights neighborhood, this delightful one-bedroom, one-bathroom home blends
the classic character with modern updates. Recently refreshed, the interior and exterior boast fresh paint, refinished hardwood floors,
 and updated fixtures, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere.
The cozy living space is bathed in natural light, as is the updated bathroom which features a fabulous skylight
while the kitchen features stainless steel appliances and a charming French door that opens up to one side of the spacious patio.
The serene bedroom offers a private retreat with its own French door leading to a beautifully secluded backyard-perfect
for gardening, entertaining, or simply unwinding. Take a few steps further back in the yard to enjoy stunning city views.
Adding to the home's convenience, the attached garage with remote, includes laundry and offers direct access to both the interior
and backyard.
Located on Banks street, this home is just moments from schools, parks, coffee shops, and the vibrant energy that Cortland Avenue
has to offer. It is conveniently located near freeway access for seamless commuting.
This delightful home has incredible potential for expansion as displayed by other homes in the neighborhood.
This gem is a must see!
